collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE V: FAMILY DRAMA, FEUDS AND LEADERSHIP DISPUTES (LCE-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
All sorts of real-life drama suited to Isola: parents with opinions about who their children marry, arranged matches, inheritances, feuds between families, accusations, apologies that are not enough, and arguments about who should lead.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Two adults whose families forbid their match plan to run away to the far side of the island: go, or stay and face their families.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) want to marry. Their families have been enemies for years and have forbidden it. Tonight, (subject) has a canoe ready, and a plan to paddle to the far side of the island and build a hut where nobody can tell them what to do. (friend) is not sure. What should they do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They go. For a season, they live on the far shore, alone and happy and a little hungry. Then (friend)'s mother paddles over, alone, with a basket of food. Then (subject)'s father. The families still do not speak to each other. They both speak to the couple.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: They stay, and tell both families together that they will marry, with or without blessing. There is shouting. There is crying. The wedding is very small and very tense. But it happens, in the village, and both families come, and sit on opposite sides.
